tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Ahrom Labs' published pages (ERP for Indian manufacturers and traders, IBR 2026 boiler forms, ASME, interior BOQs, TallyPrime integration, construction, US sales tax, AI assistants over business data). Returns passages with the URL of their page; cite it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
